title: Shinra's Basic Training
description: This is a simulated battle against infantrymen. The difficulty is set low, so it should pose no problems for a SOLDIER operative. Relax and enjoy the training.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Basic warm-up; Barrier + Battle Stance easily handles groups.

bossGuide.summary: Introductory SOLDIER simulation against Shinra Sentries. Great spot for Battle Stance practice and AFK DMW spins.
weaknessesAndCounters: Low Hard HP (945) and no elemental immunities — basic sword combos and Fire/Thunder clear in seconds.
keyAttacksToWatch: Quintuple Shot / Tonfa: Block with Guard or Battle Stance to build early Buster Sword Proficiency.
killSteps: Activate Battle Stance, block or sidestep the Sentry's Tonfa swing, and land Strong Attack.
Sweep groups with Assault Twister or basic combos.
bossGuide.proTip: Later on, M1-1-1 is the #1 AFK DMW mastering mission: equip 4x boost Materia + Regen/Auto-Potion and let Sentries hit you while you earn 100% DMW.

title: Shinra's Advanced Training
description: This is a simulated battle against Shinra's new gun bull heads. You may have fought them before, but that doesn't necessarily mean you'll win again. Overconfidence may kill you...

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) for Break HP Limit and Mog's Amulet for rare drops.

bossGuide.summary: Defeat Gun Bull Head (Lv.20, 20,520 Hard HP). No elemental weakness; Watch for Blast Shot.
weaknessesAndCounters: No elemental weaknesses — rely on non-elemental Command Materia or physical crits from behind.
Elemental Warning: Resists/Absorbs/Nulls Lightning — keep those elements off your loadout.
Balanced Defenses (VIT 14 / SPR 1): Back-attacks with Battle Stance Strong Attack or your highest-stat Materia melt HP cleanly.
Status/Effect Immunities: Poison, Silence, Stun, Stop, Death.
keyAttacksToWatch: Blast Shot (Heavy shot + Stun/Silence): Roll sideways when cannon locks on.
Silence Shot: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Gun Bull Head, and punish recovery.
killSteps: Prep & Opener: Cast Wall right away and equip Break HP Limit (Adaman Bangle from M7-3-6) if available.
Core Kill Loop: Clear surrounding adds with Darkness/Quake, then focus the boss with Aerial Drain or High Jump back-attacks.
Counter Hazards: Blast Shot (Heavy shot + Stun/Silence): Roll sideways when cannon locks on.
bossGuide.proTip: Use Buster Sword Battle Stance + Perfect Guard on telegraphed hits to build Proficiency while dealing heavy counter damage.

title: 50 Shinra Troopers
description: You will be sparring with our infantrymen., Though each individual poses little challenge, the fact that they will appear in a constant stream should even the odds., Let us see how you fare.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

bossGuide.summary: 50-wave Shinra infantry gauntlet. Bring AoE wave-clear and sustain so chip damage doesn't add up.
weaknessesAndCounters: No elemental immunities; AoE Darkness, Quake, or Assault Twister+ clears entire squads in one cast.
Raise Buster Sword Proficiency to 23%+ for Break Damage Limit on Strong Attacks.
keyAttacksToWatch: Concentrated Gunfire & Grenades: Keep Wall active so stray shots don't stagger or chip you down.
killSteps: Cast Wall and group troopers together by circling the perimeter.
Spam Darkness, Quake, or Assault Twister+ to wipe waves instantly.
Top off HP with Aerial Drain or Curaga between spawns until all 50 fall.
bossGuide.proTip: Pairing Drain/Aerial Drain with Wall lets you clear all 50 troopers without spending items.

title: 100 Shinra Troopers
description: It's another practice session, but with powered-up infantrymen—and more of them!, This should be pretty tough even for a SOLDIER operative. Give it all you've got.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

bossGuide.summary: 100-enemy Shinra survival gauntlet. AoE Command/Magic Materia and Regen/Drain sustain make it effortless.
weaknessesAndCounters: Troopers lack high magical/physical resistances — AoE Quake or Darkness hits every spawn simultaneously.
keyAttacksToWatch: Crossfire & Stun Grenades: Keep moving, maintain Wall, and stay near the edges to prevent being surrounded.
killSteps: Maintain Wall and herd enemies into tight packs.
Clear packs with Quake, Electrocute, or Darkness.
Use Aerial Drain whenever HP dips below 60% until all 100 are defeated.
bossGuide.proTip: Great early-mid spot to farm SP and DMW limit triggers while building Buster Sword Proficiency.

title: 200 Shinra Troopers
description: The enemy troopers are even tougher this time., Can you survive while defeating a seemingly never-ending stream of them?, We look forward to watching you in action.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

bossGuide.summary: 200-trooper endurance mission. Prioritize MP/HP sustain (Osmose/Aerial Drain/Regen) alongside fast AoE clears.
weaknessesAndCounters: Warrant Officers have ~94k Hard HP — Break Damage Limit (23%+ Buster Sword or Brutal) cuts clear time in half.
keyAttacksToWatch: Multi-directional rifle volleys and grenades — never stand stationary in the center of the arena.
killSteps: Open with Wall and circle-strafe to keep all troopers on one side of Zack.
Chain Quake/Darkness/Assault Twister+ and recover HP with Aerial Drain.
Refresh Wall every few waves until the 200-kill counter finishes.
bossGuide.proTip: Clear reward is HP Up++, and Warrant Officers/Combatants feed steady SP for fusion.

title: 1,000 Shinra Troopers
description: Zack, we now understand how strong you are, so here is our last training session with the most powerful infantrymen we have. They will seem truly endless, coming at you again and again and again... Are you ready for the ultimate sparring challenge?

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) for Break HP Limit and Mog's Amulet for rare drops.

bossGuide.summary: The famous 1,000-trooper marathon. Bring Genji Helm (0 MP/AP) or Osmose + Quake/Electrocute/Darkness for fast clears.
weaknessesAndCounters: Ensigns reach 122,520 Hard HP — Quake + Dualcast or Costly Punch / Assault Twister+ clears waves quickly.
0-MP/AP accessories (Genji Helm, Soul of Thamasa, Black Cowl) prevent running dry mid-marathon.
keyAttacksToWatch: Endless flanking gunfire & status/knockback hits — keep Wall up and use Aerial Drain to heal off chip damage.
killSteps: Equip AoE clear (Quake/Electrocute/Darkness) and sustain (Wall + Aerial Drain + Curaga).
Hug one edge of the map so spawns funnel in front of you rather than behind.
Rhythmically wipe waves and refresh Wall/MP until all 1,000 troopers drop for the Mug Materia reward.
bossGuide.proTip: Reward is Mug — a mandatory Materia for stealing 99x Phoenix Downs from Minerva and farming Mako/Stat Stones.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip 4 Accessory slots (M7-2-2 & M7-2-5) and Element/Status Ward.

bossGuide.summary: Defeat Bomb (Lv.22, 34,370 Hard HP). Weak to Ice. Watch for Fira.
weaknessesAndCounters: Elemental Weaknesses: Hit with Ice (Blizzara / Blizzaga) for bonus damage and faster staggers.
Elemental Warning: Resists/Absorbs/Nulls Fire — keep those elements off your loadout.
Balanced Defenses (VIT 13 / SPR 25): Back-attacks with Battle Stance Strong Attack or your highest-stat Materia melt HP cleanly.
Not listed as Stop-immune: Stop Blade or Hell-aga Materia can lock the target in place.
keyAttacksToWatch: Fira: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Bomb, and punish recovery.
"It's bigger!": Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Bomb, and punish recovery.
Self-Destruct (Kamikaze explosion): Burst down before low HP or dodge back / Aerial Drain to iframe.
killSteps: Prep & Opener: Open with Barrier (or Wall) so Hard Mode hits stay manageable.
Core Kill Loop: Use High Jump to dodge telegraphed swings and follow with Battle Stance or elemental weakness spells.
Counter Hazards: Fira: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Bomb, and punish recovery.
bossGuide.proTip: Bomb carries Fire Armlet as a Rare Steal — weave a Mug (w/ Brigand's Gloves + Mog's Amulet) before landing the killing blow.

title: Nibelheim II
description: This is a battle against monsters indigenous to Nibelheim region., Although Nibelheim is known for a wide variety of monsters, this mission will primarily feature cave-dwelling creatures.

bossGuide.summary: Defeat Sahagin (Lv.23, 61,020 Hard HP). No elemental weakness; Watch for Blizzara.
weaknessesAndCounters: No elemental weaknesses — rely on non-elemental Command Materia or physical crits from behind.

Not Death-immune: Hell Firaga / Hell Blizzaga / Hell Thundaga (+ Status Strike) can trigger instant-kill procs.
keyAttacksToWatch: Blizzara: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Sahagin, and punish recovery.
Jump: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Sahagin, and punish recovery.
MBarrier (Halves magic damage): Strip with Dispel or switch to physical Command attacks.
Squirt Gun: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Sahagin, and punish recovery.
killSteps: Prep & Opener: Cast Wall right away and equip Break HP Limit (Adaman Bangle from M7-3-6) if available.
Core Kill Loop: Clear surrounding adds with Darkness/Quake, then focus the boss with Aerial Drain or High Jump back-attacks.
Counter Hazards: Blizzara: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Sahagin, and punish recovery.
bossGuide.proTip: Use Buster Sword Battle Stance + Perfect Guard on telegraphed hits to build Proficiency while dealing heavy counter damage.

title: Experiment No. 101
description: Your battle with the summon made for valuable data., I have used this data to create a new battle sim; be my guest and give it a try if you're up to it., But I must warn you; though it is only a simulation, the damage you receive will be very real.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Keep Barrier up and practice Perfect Guards in Battle Stance.

bossGuide.summary: Classic fire summon boss weak to Ice. Keep Barrier up and break Hellfire's gauge to win cleanly.
weaknessesAndCounters: Weak to Ice — Blizzara/Blizzaga and Blizzard Blade deal bonus damage and stagger him faster.
Absorbs Fire — never cast Fire/Fira/Hell Firaga or you will heal him.
keyAttacksToWatch: Hellfire: Limit Gauge finisher — unload Ice spells and Strong Attacks during the countdown to drop the gauge.
Crimson Rush / Fireball: Telegraphed lunge and fire projectiles — dodge sideways and punish from his flank.
killSteps: Cast Barrier at the start and lock on while strafing around Ifrit's melee swings.
Spam Blizzara/Blizzaga from mid-range or weave Battle Stance combos after dodging his lunge.
Focus everything into breaking the Hellfire gauge when he charges, then finish with Ice burst.
bossGuide.proTip: Equipping Flame Armlet or Fire-warding accessories trivializes his fire attacks even on Hard Mode.

title: Experiment No. 102
description: Bahamut! A rare find indeed..., I thank you for such an invaluable sample., I have created another battle simulation based on this data, so have at it once you're ready.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

bossGuide.summary: Aerial dragon boss with no elemental weaknesses. Dodge claw swipes, jump through beams, and break Megaflare.
weaknessesAndCounters: No elemental weaknesses; relies on balanced physical and non-elemental beam damage.
High Jump / Aerial Drain grants invincibility frames to dodge sweeping breath attacks while dealing heavy physical hits.
keyAttacksToWatch: Megaflare: Major Limit Gauge laser — burst the gauge to minimize damage or hold Wall + full HP.
Flare Breath / Claw Combo: Wide front cone — dodge behind Bahamut's wings to stay safe.
killSteps: Apply Wall or Barrier/MBarrier immediately at the start of the fight.
Stay behind or beside Bahamut, using High Jump or Battle Stance slashes after his claw combos.
Save Limit Breaks or high-damage Command Materia to shatter the Megaflare gauge.
bossGuide.proTip: Watch Bahamut's wings: when he hovers back to charge a beam, trigger High Jump to evade completely and land a counter.

title: Experiment No. 103
description: I already know it's a failure, so I'm not especially keen on this... but I did re-create an Angeal copy based on combat intel., It's just a monster with a little bit of intelligence., On second thought, it's probably a perfect match.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Keep Barrier up and practice Perfect Guards in Battle Stance.

bossGuide.summary: Defeat A-Sahagin (Lv.13, 9,930 Hard HP). No elemental weakness; Watch for Jump.
weaknessesAndCounters: No elemental weaknesses — rely on non-elemental Command Materia or physical crits from behind.
Magic Resistant (SPR 47 vs VIT 13): Physical Command Materia (High Jump, Aerial Drain, Assault Twister+, Battle Stance) hits hardest.
Not Death-immune: Hell Firaga / Hell Blizzaga / Hell Thundaga (+ Status Strike) can trigger instant-kill procs.
keyAttacksToWatch: Jump: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind A-Sahagin, and punish recovery.
Poison Thrust: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind A-Sahagin, and punish recovery.
killSteps: Prep & Opener: Cast Barrier if needed, lock on, and circle behind the target.
Core Kill Loop: Weave Battle Stance Strong Attacks and Assault Twister into the enemy's back for guaranteed crits.
Counter Hazards: Jump: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind A-Sahagin, and punish recovery.
bossGuide.proTip: A-Sahagin carries Blizzard as a Rare Steal — weave a Mug (w/ Brigand's Gloves + Mog's Amulet) before landing the killing blow.

title: Experiment No. 104
description: A very intriguing sample. A Bahamut strain!, Genesis has more than a few tricks up his sleeve. So, this is a simulated battle; with special thanks to Genesis., Allow me to collect more combat data while you dish out the hurt.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

bossGuide.summary: 9★ Hard Mode cosmic dragon boss. Hits very hard with Exaflare and Cluster projectiles; bring Break HP Limit + Wall.
weaknessesAndCounters: No elemental weakness and immune to most ailments — pure non-elemental Costly Punch + Aerial Drain is king.
High Hard Mode HP (353,970) rewards Break Damage Limit (Brutal or Buster Sword 23%+).
keyAttacksToWatch: Exaflare: Screen-filling Limit Gauge blast — break the gauge with Costly Punch or hold Wall + Auto-Raise (Phoenix Down).
Cluster / Hexafang: Tracking energy spheres and dash strikes — dodge sideways continuously until the salvo finishes.
killSteps: Pop Phoenix Down and Wall immediately at mission start.
Dash laterally through Cluster volleys, then close in for Costly Punch or Aerial Drain.
Break Exaflare's gauge with rapid Costly Punch hits to prevent heavy party-wipe damage.
bossGuide.proTip: Aerial Drain's hang-time dodges Hexafang cleanly while topping off your HP bar.

title: Experiment No. 105
description: Is Genesis dead?, Actually, that is of no concern to me—my interest lay only in his abilities., He showed remarkable growth for a failed experiment. Far more promising than you.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Unlock Costly Punch + Brutal (M7-4-6) and deplete boss Skill Power gauges.

bossGuide.summary: Fast swordsman & mage boss who chains Black Flurry and Dark Energy. Guard his slashes and punish recovery.
weaknessesAndCounters: Immune to instant-death cheese and most statuses; weak to aggressive stagger pressure after his sword combos.
Physical attacks from behind or during Dark Energy recovery deal reliable criticals.
keyAttacksToWatch: Black Flurry / Apocalypse: Multi-hit dark slash and beam — guard or dash wide around him.
Dark Energy / Homing Fireballs: Circle-strafe until orbs dissipate before rushing in.
killSteps: Keep Wall active and stay mid-range to read his sword dash tells.
Guard or dodge behind his 3-hit slash combo, then counter with Costly Punch or Battle Stance Strong Attack.
Burn the Limit Gauge if Apocalypse begins charging, and heal with Curaga between waves.
bossGuide.proTip: Buster Sword Stance Guard absorbs Genesis's physical flurries and turns every parry into a boosted punish.

title: Experiment No. 106
description: Too bad about Angeal. He could have lived longer had he only returned to Shinra., I would have preferred to get his body back to my lab... but at the very least, I retrieved some data from which I created a simulation of his final state., Perhaps you might be able to tell just how faithful a reproduction it is...

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip 4 Accessory slots (M7-2-2 & M7-2-5) and Element/Status Ward.

bossGuide.summary: Winged boss with directional Defense of Lust counter-stance and elemental wing attacks. Always flank behind him.
weaknessesAndCounters: No elemental weaknesses; punishes frontal attacks whenever his Defense of Lust shield is raised.
Always circle to his back — back-attacks bypass Defense of Lust and score guaranteed crits.
keyAttacksToWatch: Charge of Greed / Thunder of Envy: Lightning and rush attacks — equip Thunder/Lightning ward or Wall and dodge laterally.
Wings of Pride: Heavy Limit Gauge attack — burst the gauge down from behind.
killSteps: Cast Wall and immediately roll behind Angeal Penance.
Pause frontal strikes when he raises his wing guard (Defense of Lust) and reposition behind him.
Use High Jump or Assault Twister+ into his back until he falls.
bossGuide.proTip: Never mash into his front guard — one dash behind him turns Defense of Lust into a free damage window.

title: Experiment No. 107
description: Is the hero really dead?, Things would have been more interesting if only I had arrived at Nibelheim a bit sooner..., We'll have to settle a simulation based on the data left in the monitoring system at the mako reactor.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) for Break HP Limit and Mog's Amulet for rare drops.

bossGuide.summary: Deadly duelist featuring Heartless Angel (drops HP to 1) and Octaslash. Keep a fast heal ready at all times.
weaknessesAndCounters: Immune to Death and Stop; vulnerable to quick counter-attacks right after his Masamune dash combos.
Keep X-Potions/Elixirs or Curaga slotted next to your primary attack for instant Heartless Angel recovery.
keyAttacksToWatch: Heartless Angel: Drops Zack's HP to 1 — dodge or immediately cast Curaga/X-Potion before his next slash.
Telluric Fury / Shadow Flare: Wide ground wave and tracking dark orbs — sidestep and keep moving.
Octaslash: Limit Gauge finisher — burst the gauge down to avoid lethal multi-slash damage.
killSteps: Apply Wall and Phoenix Down at the start so a sudden Heartless Angel combo cannot end the run.
Stay at medium range, dodge his Masamune lunge, and punish his back with High Jump or Costly Punch.
The instant you see Heartless Angel, cancel into Curaga or an X-Potion before re-engaging.
bossGuide.proTip: If you stay close and stun/interrupt him during Heartless Angel's hover windup, you can sometimes cancel it altogether.

title: Experiment No. 108
description: I wonder if Sephiroth gave his all fighting you?, It's too bad the monitoring system cannot record the subject's mind as well. Still, the data shows significant strength., Could he have accepted you as a SOLDIER member? An interesting state he was in...

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) for Break HP Limit and Mog's Amulet for rare drops.

bossGuide.summary: Sephiroth backed by Fire, Blizzard, Thunder, and Support Materia orbs. Destroy the Support/Elemental orbs first.
weaknessesAndCounters: Destroying the 4 floating Materia orbs strips Sephiroth's elemental barrage and buff/heal support.
AoE Darkness, Quake, or Assault Twister+ clips multiple orbs while damaging Sephiroth.
keyAttacksToWatch: Heartless Angel: Drops HP to 1 — follow immediately with Curaga or X-Potion.
Synchronized Firaga/Blizzaga/Thundaga from the orbs — keep Wall up and prioritize the Support Materia orb first.
killSteps: Cast Wall + Phoenix Down, then immediately target and destroy Support Materia and the elemental orbs.
Use Quake/Darkness or Aerial Drain to clear remaining orbs while dodging Sephiroth's lunges.
Once alone, punish Sephiroth's sword swings and heal instantly after any Heartless Angel.
bossGuide.proTip: Killing the Support Materia orb first stops it from buffing and supporting Sephiroth throughout the fight.

title: Experiment No. 109

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) for Break HP Limit and Mog's Amulet for rare drops.

bossGuide.summary: Ailment-spamming boss who summons Land Worms and heals himself. Status immunity (Ribbon / Status Ward) trivializes him.
weaknessesAndCounters: Hollander's main threat is Poison, Silence, Curse, and Stop flasks — equip Ribbon or Status Ward + Hell-aga for 100% status immunity.
High burst damage stops him from out-healing with potions/Curaga and clears summoned Land Worms fast.
keyAttacksToWatch: Status Flasks / Bad Breath-style debuffs: Blocked completely by Status Ward + Hell Firaga/Blizzaga.
Land Worm Summon + Self-Heal: Wipe Land Worms with AoE Darkness/Quake so they don't Stop-lock you.
killSteps: Equip Status Ward + a Hell-aga Materia (or Ribbon) before starting the mission.
Open with Wall and rush Hollander down with Costly Punch or High Jump.
Clear any spawned Land Worms immediately with AoE Command/Magic Materia, then finish Hollander.
bossGuide.proTip: A single Hell Firaga/Blizzaga + Status Ward combo completely shuts down both Hollander's flasks and Land Worm Stop.

unlockCondition: In Chapter 3, talk to the SOLDIER 3rd class in the Shinra HQ Briefing Room

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Basic warm-up; Barrier + Battle Stance easily handles groups.

bossGuide.summary: Defeat Heli Gunner (Lv.8, 3,170 Hard HP). Weak to Lightning. Watch for AB Cannon.
weaknessesAndCounters: Elemental Weaknesses: Hit with Lightning (Thundara / Thundaga) for bonus damage and faster staggers.
Physical Tank (VIT 163 vs SPR 72): Magic attacks (Firaga/Blizzaga/Electrocute/Energy) or Costly Punch outperform basic slashes.
Status/Effect Immunities: Poison, Silence, Stun, Stop, Death.
keyAttacksToWatch: AB Cannon: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Heli Gunner, and punish recovery.
Spin Attack: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Heli Gunner, and punish recovery.
killSteps: Prep & Opener: Cast Barrier if needed, lock on, and circle behind the target.
Core Kill Loop: Weave Battle Stance Strong Attacks and Assault Twister into the enemy's back for guaranteed crits.
Counter Hazards: AB Cannon: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Heli Gunner, and punish recovery.
bossGuide.proTip: Use Buster Sword Battle Stance + Perfect Guard on telegraphed hits to build Proficiency while dealing heavy counter damage.

bossGuide.summary: Defeat Hedgehog Pie (Lv.10, 8,270 Hard HP). No elemental weakness; Watch for Fire.
weaknessesAndCounters: No elemental weaknesses — rely on non-elemental Command Materia or physical crits from behind.
Balanced Defenses (VIT 6 / SPR 18): Back-attacks with Battle Stance Strong Attack or your highest-stat Materia melt HP cleanly.

Core Kill Loop: Weave Battle Stance Strong Attacks and Assault Twister into the enemy's back for guaranteed crits.
Counter Hazards: Fire: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Hedgehog Pie, and punish recovery.
bossGuide.proTip: Use Buster Sword Battle Stance + Perfect Guard on telegraphed hits to build Proficiency while dealing heavy counter damage.

description: After the mysterious energy's influence, we are sure that its source is just beyond here., There's no telling what you may find, but we've come too far to turn back now., We look forward to reading your report, Zack!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Superboss Minerva (20,000,000 HP on Hard Mode): 255 VIT/SPR, 99,999 HP, Wall, Costly Punch, Aerial Drain, Mug (steal 99 Phoenix Downs), Genji set.

routeNotes: Superboss Arena: single direct fight against Minerva (20,000,000 HP). Pop Phoenix Down + Wall, Mug once for 99x Phoenix Downs, and loop Costly Punch.

bossGuide.summary: Hard Mode's ultimate 20,000,000 HP superboss. Requires 99,999 HP, 255 VIT & SPR, Costly Punch, and Mug for 99x Phoenix Downs.
weaknessesAndCounters: No elemental weaknesses; halves/resists Fire, Ice, and Lightning — use defense-ignoring Costly Punch (99,999 dmg per swing).
Immune to all status ailments, Gravity, and Death; SP Master + Genji Shield/Ziedrich keeps damage survivable.
Carries 99x Phoenix Downs as Rare Steal — use Mug with Mog's Amulet + Brigand's Gloves (or Heike Soul) to restock Raise mid-fight.
keyAttacksToWatch: Judgment Arrow: Ultimate attack — breaks your Auto-Raise (Reraise) buff and hits hard; break her Limit Gauge during windup or immediately reapply Phoenix Down.
Photon Feather / Crimson Flare: Rapid homing orbs and flame pillars — sidestep/dash perpendicularly or iframe with Aerial Drain.
Thor's Hammer / Krysta: Heavy lightning/ice bursts — keep Wall active and heal immediately with Curaga.
killSteps: Open with Phoenix Down (Auto-Raise) and Wall, then Mug Minerva once to snag 99x Phoenix Downs.
Circle behind Minerva, dodge her Photon Feathers/slashed combos, and punish openings with Costly Punch for 99,999 damage.
When she charges Judgment Arrow, burst the gauge down to reduce damage; if Judgment Arrow lands, immediately use another Phoenix Down.
Keep HP above 40,000 with Curaga/X-Potions (staying below ~110% HP threshold if needed for Costly Punch, though 99,999 HP works cleanly) until 20M HP hits zero.
bossGuide.proTip: Judgment Arrow removes Auto-Raise even if you survive it — make re-popping a Phoenix Down your #1 reflex right after the animation ends.

title: Where's the Cactuar?
description: One of our executives has lost his pet Cactuar., It seems the prickly pet has disappeared with classified company information in its hands. This security breach must be dealt with at once., A door-to-door investigation by Shinra has revealed the Cactuar to be in the wasteland. Exterminate it on sight.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

bossGuide.summary: Nimble desert Cactoid that fires fixed-damage 1,000 Needles. Keep HP > 1,500 and rush it down.
weaknessesAndCounters: Low HP pool; fast-startup Command Materia or basic melee combos finish Kactuar before it flees or spams Needles.
keyAttacksToWatch: 1,000 Needles: Deals fixed 1,000 damage ignoring defense — dodge sideways when it stops and shakes.
killSteps: Keep HP above 1,500 at all times so 1,000 Needles cannot one-shot you.
Close distance with dash attacks or High Jump to interrupt its Needle windup.
Finish Kactuar quickly before Raijincho lightning adds chip your HP.
bossGuide.proTip: Fixed-damage Needle attacks bypass VIT/Barrier — raw max HP is your best safety net.

title: Kactuar?
description: The Cactuar found in the last mission was only a look-alike., Another thorough investigation by Shinra has revealed the Cactuar to be in the wasteland., This one has got to be our executive's Cactuar! Exterminate it immediately!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

bossGuide.summary: Second Cactoid hunt with Raijincho & Trap support. Watch for 1,000 Needles fixed damage.
weaknessesAndCounters: Low HP; burst Kactuar immediately and avoid Raijincho's Lightning strikes.
keyAttacksToWatch: 1,000 Needles: Fixed 1,000 damage — roll sideways out of line-of-sight.
killSteps: Maintain HP > 1,500 and rush Kactuar down first.
Dodge sideways on Needle windup and punish with High Jump / Strong Attack.
bossGuide.proTip: Grab the Cursed Ring / AP Up chest along the path before ending the mission.

title: Cactuar Found?
description: If we leave things as is, it is only a matter of time before sensitive information is leaked and heads roll., We must, for the sake of these heads, find the Cactuar at all cost., Further investigation has determined its location to be in the wasteland. There is no time to lose!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip 4 Accessory slots (M7-2-2 & M7-2-5) and Element/Status Ward.

bossGuide.summary: King Cactoid boss armed with 10,000 Needles! Keep HP above 10,000 or dodge every Needle volley.
weaknessesAndCounters: Low overall HP for its threat level — High Jump or Costly Punch ends the fight in a few clean hits.
10,000 Needles ignores VIT/Wall, so Break HP Limit (Adaman Bangle or +HP% Materia) prevents one-shots.
keyAttacksToWatch: 10,000 Needles: Fixed 10,000 damage — fatal if HP ≤ 9,999! Dodge laterally or jump over it with High Jump/Aerial Drain.
killSteps: Boost max HP over 10,500 (via HP Up% Materia or Adaman Bangle) or bring Phoenix Down.
Track Kactuer closely and punish its pauses with High Jump or Costly Punch.
Heal immediately after any 10,000 Needles hit and finish it to earn the Cactus Thorn (Cactuar DMW).
bossGuide.proTip: Completing M10-1-3 awards Cactus Thorn, unlocking Cactuar on your DMW!

title: Find the Tonberry!
description: Our president's personal chef has requested that we reclaim his prized knife of legend., Investigation has revealed that a Tonberry in the coal mines is currently in possession of the knife., Defeat the Tonberry and claim the cutlery!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

bossGuide.summary: Slow but lethal close-range stalker with Chef's Knife & Everyone's Grudge. Kite and strike from behind.
weaknessesAndCounters: Very slow movement speed — ranged magic and Jump attacks hit safely without entering Chef's Knife range.
keyAttacksToWatch: Chef's Knife / Everyone's Grudge: Heavy close-range stab & grudge damage — never trade hits face-to-face.
killSteps: Stay out of melee range until Tonberry finishes its slow step forward.
Flank behind Tonberry and strike with High Jump or elemental spells, then back out.
bossGuide.proTip: Never stand directly in front of a Tonberry; circle behind it for safe critical hits.

title: Tonberries Everywhere
description: The kitchen knife possessed by the previous Tonberry was not the chef's legendary knife., But we have new information about another Tonberry with the chef's precious cutlery., Hurry there and defeat the Tonberry!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

bossGuide.summary: Swarm of Tonberries in the cavern. Avoid getting cornered by multiple Chef's Knives at once.
weaknessesAndCounters: Slow walk speed lets you kite packs in circles and cleave them with Darkness or Assault Twister.
keyAttacksToWatch: Chef's Knife / Everyone's Grudge: High burst if two Tonberries stab together — keep moving.
killSteps: Kite the Tonberry group into a tight cluster.
Drop AoE Darkness/Quake or High Jump in and roll back out.
Pick off survivors from behind.
bossGuide.proTip: Watch your mini-map corners so you don't back into a trailing Tonberry.

title: Master Tonberry
description: Despite the number of Tonberries in the last mission, not one held the chef's legendary knife., But the latest news is the most reliable yet., The Master Tonberry in the caves is in possession of it! Go slay the Master Tonberry!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

routeNotes: Equip Jump, Fira, Gravity, and Assault Twister before entering. Trigger random battles until Magic Pot appears, obey its 4 requests for the Magic Pot DMW, then clear Master Tonberry for Tonberry's Knife.

bossGuide.summary: King of Tonberries with lethal Chef's Knife & Everyone's Grudge (plus optional Magic Pot encounters). Stay mobile!
weaknessesAndCounters: Slow turning speed makes back-attacks easy; Aerial Drain / High Jump dodges Chef's Knife cleanly.
Magic Pot can spawn in random encounters here — bring Jump, Fira, Gravity, and Assault Twister if hunting its DMW.
keyAttacksToWatch: Chef's Knife & Everyone's Grudge: Massive burst at close range — dodge behind him or use Jump i-frames.
killSteps: Apply Wall and kite Master Tonberry into open space.
Bait his Chef's Knife lunge, roll behind him, and punish with High Jump/Costly Punch.
Finish Master Tonberry to claim Tonberry's Knife and unlock Tonberry on your DMW.
bossGuide.proTip: Clearing M10-2-3 awards Tonberry's Knife (Tonberry DMW). Don't attack Magic Pot if it appears — match its 4 skill requests!

title: Vacation Time
description: You are hereby granted a vacation to Shinra's own resort, Costa del Sol., We hope the time off will relieve some of your stress.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

bossGuide.summary: Defeat G Diver (Lv.17, 19,060 Hard HP). No elemental weakness; Watch for Triple Shot.
weaknessesAndCounters: No elemental weaknesses — rely on non-elemental Command Materia or physical crits from behind.
Magic Resistant (SPR 33 vs VIT 21): Physical Command Materia (High Jump, Aerial Drain, Assault Twister+, Battle Stance) hits hardest.
Not listed as Stop-immune: Stop Blade or Hell-aga Materia can lock the target in place.
keyAttacksToWatch: Triple Shot: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind G Diver, and punish recovery.
Fin Kick: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind G Diver, and punish recovery.
killSteps: Prep & Opener: Cast Wall right away and equip Break HP Limit (Adaman Bangle from M7-3-6) if available.
Core Kill Loop: Clear surrounding adds with Darkness/Quake, then focus the boss with Aerial Drain or High Jump back-attacks.
Counter Hazards: Triple Shot: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind G Diver, and punish recovery.
bossGuide.proTip: Equip Mog's Amulet (Sector 7 Shop, M4-4-3) to guarantee G Diver's Rare Drop: Blizzard.

title: Vacation for Real
description: Your previous break was rudely interrupted by an attacking Genesis battalion, so here is your permit for a real vacation in Costa del Sol., We hope you enjoy your time off.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip 4 Accessory slots (M7-2-2 & M7-2-5) and Element/Status Ward.

bossGuide.summary: Defeat Water Warrior (Lv.26, 80,960 Hard HP). No elemental weakness; Watch for Barrier.
weaknessesAndCounters: No elemental weaknesses — rely on non-elemental Command Materia or physical crits from behind.
Elemental Warning: Resists/Absorbs/Nulls Lightning, Fire — keep those elements off your loadout.
Balanced Defenses (VIT 12 / SPR 13): Back-attacks with Battle Stance Strong Attack or your highest-stat Materia melt HP cleanly.
Status/Effect Immunities: Ice, Poison, Stun, Stop, Death.
keyAttacksToWatch: Barrier (Halves physical damage): Strip with Dispel, switch to Magic, or pierce with Costly Punch.
Cure: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Water Warrior, and punish recovery.
Jump: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Water Warrior, and punish recovery.
MBarrier (Halves magic damage): Strip with Dispel or switch to physical Command attacks.
killSteps: Prep & Opener: Open with Barrier (or Wall) so Hard Mode hits stay manageable.
Core Kill Loop: Use High Jump to dodge telegraphed swings and follow with Battle Stance or elemental weakness spells.
Counter Hazards: Barrier (Halves physical damage): Strip with Dispel, switch to Magic, or pierce with Costly Punch.
bossGuide.proTip: Equip Mog's Amulet (Sector 7 Shop, M4-4-3) to guarantee Water Warrior's Rare Drop: Blizzaga.

title: Please Make it a Vacation
description: We never would have thought Sahagins lived in the waters of Costa del Sol., Please enjoy some real time off at our exclusive resort. The third time is the charm!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

bossGuide.summary: Defeat Steam Engine (Lv.34, 181,980 Hard HP). Weak to Ice. Watch for Firaga.
weaknessesAndCounters: Elemental Weaknesses: Hit with Ice (Blizzara / Blizzaga) for bonus damage and faster staggers.
Elemental Warning: Resists/Absorbs/Nulls Fire — keep those elements off your loadout.
Balanced Defenses (VIT 32 / SPR 40): Back-attacks with Battle Stance Strong Attack or your highest-stat Materia melt HP cleanly.
Not listed as Stop-immune: Stop Blade or Hell-aga Materia can lock the target in place.
keyAttacksToWatch: Firaga (Heavy Fire AoE): Dodge out of the flame ring or equip Fire Armlet / Flame Armlet.
Self-Destruct (Kamikaze explosion): Burst down before low HP or dodge back / Aerial Drain to iframe.
killSteps: Prep & Opener: Cast Wall right away and equip Break HP Limit (Adaman Bangle from M7-3-6) if available.
Core Kill Loop: Clear surrounding adds with Darkness/Quake, then focus the boss with Aerial Drain or High Jump back-attacks.
Counter Hazards: Firaga (Heavy Fire AoE): Dodge out of the flame ring or equip Fire Armlet / Flame Armlet.
bossGuide.proTip: Steam Engine carries VIT Mako Stone as a Rare Steal — weave a Mug (w/ Brigand's Gloves + Mog's Amulet) before landing the killing blow.

subGroup: M10-4: More Fun in the Sun!
title: You Need a Vacation
description: Even the meteorological bureau was surprised to hear that the rise in water temperature at Costa del Sol was being caused by Bombs., We can't blame you for convulsions of nature, so here is your permit for another break.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip 4 Accessory slots (M7-2-2 & M7-2-5) and Element/Status Ward.

bossGuide.summary: Defeat Coast Runner (Lv.22, 174,990 Hard HP). No elemental weakness; Flank from behind and punish recovery.
weaknessesAndCounters: No elemental weaknesses — rely on non-elemental Command Materia or physical crits from behind.
Balanced Defenses (VIT 9 / SPR 3): Back-attacks with Battle Stance Strong Attack or your highest-stat Materia melt HP cleanly.
Not listed as Stop-immune: Stop Blade or Hell-aga Materia can lock the target in place.
keyAttacksToWatch: Standard Fiend melee & ranged volleys: Guard in Battle Stance or roll behind Coast Runner before countering.
killSteps: Prep & Opener: Open with Barrier (or Wall) so Hard Mode hits stay manageable.
Core Kill Loop: Use High Jump to dodge telegraphed swings and follow with Battle Stance or elemental weakness spells.
Counter Hazards: Standard Fiend melee & ranged volleys: Guard in Battle Stance or roll behind Coast Runner before countering.
bossGuide.proTip: Coast Runner carries LCK Mako Stone as a Rare Steal — weave a Mug (w/ Brigand's Gloves + Mog's Amulet) before landing the killing blow.

subGroup: M10-4: More Fun in the Sun!
title: We Hope it's a Vacation
description: We don't know what else to call it but bad luck; both you and Dr. Hojo were taking your breaks at Costa del Sol at the same time., You deserve a real vacation, so here is your permit., Please try to make it count this time.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Keep Barrier up and practice Perfect Guards in Battle Stance.

bossGuide.summary: Defeat Sea Worm (Lv.14, 108,110 Hard HP). Weak to Ice. Watch for Spider Web.
weaknessesAndCounters: Elemental Weaknesses: Hit with Ice (Blizzara / Blizzaga) for bonus damage and faster staggers.
Balanced Defenses (VIT 7 / SPR 12): Back-attacks with Battle Stance Strong Attack or your highest-stat Materia melt HP cleanly.
Status/Effect Immunities: Poison, Silence, Stop, Death.
keyAttacksToWatch: Spider Web: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Sea Worm, and punish recovery.
killSteps: Prep & Opener: Cast Barrier if needed, lock on, and circle behind the target.
Core Kill Loop: Weave Battle Stance Strong Attacks and Assault Twister into the enemy's back for guaranteed crits.
Counter Hazards: Spider Web: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Sea Worm, and punish recovery.
bossGuide.proTip: Sea Worm carries MP Mako Stone as a Rare Steal — weave a Mug (w/ Brigand's Gloves + Mog's Amulet) before landing the killing blow.

subGroup: M10-4: More Fun in the Sun!
title: Is it a Vacation Yet?
description: If word has come out that Costa del Sol had an abnormal growth in its sea worm population, it would have spelled the end of our prized resort., As a token of our appreciation for defending its image, here is a permit for one last vacation at Costa del Sol., But, we're sorry to say this is your last one...

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) for Break HP Limit and Mog's Amulet for rare drops.

bossGuide.summary: Defeat Sea Hulk (Lv.36, 425,765 Hard HP). No elemental weakness; Watch for Double Claw Swipe.
weaknessesAndCounters: No elemental weaknesses — rely on non-elemental Command Materia or physical crits from behind.
Balanced Defenses (VIT 22 / SPR 23): Back-attacks with Battle Stance Strong Attack or your highest-stat Materia melt HP cleanly.
Status/Effect Immunities: Poison, Stun, Stop, Death.
keyAttacksToWatch: Double Claw Swipe: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Sea Hulk, and punish recovery.
Double Tail Swipe: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Sea Hulk, and punish recovery.
Gyro Tail: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Sea Hulk, and punish recovery.
Heave: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Sea Hulk, and punish recovery.
killSteps: Prep & Opener: Cast Wall right away and equip Break HP Limit (Adaman Bangle from M7-3-6) if available.
Core Kill Loop: Clear surrounding adds with Darkness/Quake, then focus the boss with Aerial Drain or High Jump back-attacks.
Counter Hazards: Double Claw Swipe: Watch the windup animation, dodge diagonally behind Sea Hulk, and punish recovery.
bossGuide.proTip: Sea Hulk carries Titanium Bangle as a Rare Steal — weave a Mug (w/ Brigand's Gloves + Mog's Amulet) before landing the killing blow.
